submissions.title: Kentucky PSC Approves 482 MW Power Agreement for TeraWulf's Justified Data Campus
submissions.excerpt: Kentucky Public Service Commission approved a 482 MW Retail Electric Service Agreement for TeraWulf's Justified Data Campus
submissions.note: New confirmed power figure and first capex estimate for the Hancock County (Hawesville) campus: KY PSC approved a 482 MW Retail Electric Service Agreement (Big Rivers Electric Corp. / Kenergy Corp.) on the Aug 21, 2026 order, above the 401 MW critical-IT figure currently on record (which is the Anthropic lease's contracted IT load, not the site's full electrical service agreement — distinguishing site power vs. IT load here). TeraWulf separately estimated site development plus initial data hall investment at $4.0-4.5B; no capex is currently recorded for this project. Could not confirm this exact press release's date directly (WebFetch to primary sources was unavailable in this run; date inferred from secondary syndication and search summary of the PSC order) -- reviewer should verify the release date and exact RESA terms before promoting.

claims.methodology: Kentucky PSC order approving a Retail Electric Service Agreement for the full campus, per company press release and syndicated coverage; not independently verified against the PSC docket in this run.
Company-stated estimate range of $4.0-4.5B for site development and initial data hall investment; upper bound recorded, treat as a range not a point estimate.

submissions.title: Northwest Iowa town votes against a data center moratorium
submissions.excerpt: Salix City Council voted 3-2 against a one-year moratorium on data centers
submissions.suggestedProjectName: Google / MidAmerican Energy Salix Data Center
submissions.note: SITING RESTRICTION: not currently tracked. Salix, Iowa (Woodbury County, near Sioux City) annexed ~900 acres in April 2026 for a potential data center; MidAmerican Energy is the initiating utility partner and Google was identified in early August 2026 as the prospective customer. On Aug 21, 2026 the city council voted 3-2 to reject a proposed one-year moratorium, clearing the path for the project to keep moving locally -- no MW, capex, or formal site agreement has been disclosed yet, so this is a siting-status signal (zoning/moratorium vote), not a confirmed project. Worth tracking as RUMORED/PLANNING given Google's involvement is still informal per reporting.

submissions.title: Pure DC Launches One of Europe's Largest Ever AI Infrastructure Projects: Phase 1 (110MW) of an over EUR7.5 Billion, 550MW AI Campus in Seinajoki
submissions.excerpt: Phase 1 (110MW) of an over EUR7.5 Billion, 550MW AI Campus in Seinajoki, begins fully leased
submissions.note: New project, not currently tracked (Finland currently has only Nebius Lappeenranta on record). Phase 1: 110 MW IT capacity, over EUR1.5B (~US$1.7B) investment, already fully leased with substation live and planning/power secured; Microsoft named as a customer. Full campus target: over 550 MW, over EUR7.5B (~US$8.6B), 'subject to the necessary permissions and contracting' -- treat the full-campus figures as an unconfirmed ceiling, Phase 1 as the near-term committed scope. Flagging despite the ~6-week-old publication date (outside the usual 24-72h window) because it does not appear to have been surfaced in prior daily runs and clears the >=100MW/>=$1B bar by a wide margin.
